name: Shizuku Droplet Ring
description: A single rounded bead of silver sits on a slim band, like a droplet caught mid-fall. Minimal, wearable, quietly reflective.

name: Sazanami Ripple Band
description: Fine concentric ripples are hand-textured across a narrow gold band, catching light the way wind catches water.

name: Seigaiha Wave Signet
description: A low-relief take on the traditional Japanese seigaiha wave pattern, set into a soft rose gold signet face.

name: Tsuki Moonwater Band
description: A brushed titanium band with a polished channel running through it, like moonlight laid across a dark tide.

name: Shio Tideline Stacking Ring
description: A thin, uneven line traces the band like a tideline left in sand. Designed to be stacked two or three at once.

name: Sazanami Ripple Band, Dark
description: The same hand-rippled texture, cast in a deep blackened titanium for a quieter, more shadowed water.

name: Shizuku Droplet Ring, Gold
description: The droplet form in solid 14k gold — heavier, warmer, built as an everyday piece that ages well.

name: Seigaiha Wave Signet, Silver
description: The wave signet in sterling silver — a cooler, more understated read of the same pattern.
